column1: 1. New role added: PRE-PROCESSOR — converts yard bales into factory-ready feedstock
(PET flakes cold/hot-washed, granules, granulated copper, shredded steel, tyre chips/crumb, battery fractions,
dismantled e-waste fractions, C&D aggregates, reclaimed foundry sand, re-refined oil).
Maps to KSPCB list: Orange 1326 (PET flakes), 1366 (plastic reprocessing), 1405 (scrapping centres/ELV),
White 58 (UCO collection), White 3 (paper baling — the YARD step).
2. CPCB New Category List (12.02.2025 directions): 419 sectors — Red 125, Orange 137, Green 94, White 54, Blue 9.
PI ranges: Red ≥80 | Orange 55–80 | Green 25–55 | White <25 | Blue = 9 Essential Environmental Services.
White-category units are consent-exempt (G.S.R. 702(E), 12.11.2024) — self-declare + intimation to SPCB/PCC.
Blue category (9): EES for domestic waste — STP, MSW facility, sanitary landfill, MRF, C&D facility,
bio-methanation, waste-to-energy, sewage/drainage networks, E-waste collection — 2 extra years CTO validity.
3. ACTION for integration: re-verify each industry's 2025 category against Annexure-I of the CPCB report
('Classification of Sectors into Red, Orange, Green, White and Blue Categories', Jan 2025) before hard-coding
consent validity in the rulebook — the 2025 list supersedes the 2016 KSPCB classification this sheet is built on.
4. Consent validity (per KSPCB Notification 1425, 15.06.2016 — pre-2025 regime): Red = 5 yrs, Orange = 5 yrs,
Green = 10 yrs, White = no consent. Under CPCB 2025: PI decides the category; check the new SOP.
